text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali chairs a cabinet meeting on water resources management.
- Central Council of Constitutional Democratic Rallye (RCD, ruling party) starts on Thursday a three-day meeting on reforming structures and methods of action at the grassroots.
- Tunisia, Austria investment agreement goes into force.
- President on Wednesday discussed with prime minister Tunisia's relations with international financial institutions.
